blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fisherfolk and artists in Gubat, Sorsogon, turned a photography and poetry gathering into an expression of opposition to proposed coastal road projects, drawing attention to concerns about the bay’s environment and the livelihoods tied to it. The activity, “LAKAT-LENTE nan RAWIT-DAWIT SA BAYBAYON: Photowalk x Poetry Reading at Gubat Bay,” held Oct. 3, brought together fisherfolk, coastal residents, photographers, artists, poets, environmental advocates, students and other community members. Organized by the Kurit-Lagting Art Collective with the Save Gubat Bay Movement (SGBM) and Rhymes of PEG, the activity was part of Scott Kelby’s Worldwide Photowalk 2026 and Design Week […]...
